about: A column's declared type is checked before any row is read (ADR-0023): a type outside the vocabulary, cast in from outside it, is refused by the Query that names the column, whatever the rows hold.

cases.name: ADR-0023: a sort on a column of an undeclared type is refused, even over no rows
ADR-0023: a filter on a column of an undeclared type is refused, even over no rows
ADR-0023: a column of an undeclared type no Query names is not read
